name: Google
culture: Engineering-driven culture focusing on massive scalability, clean algorithmic efficiency, robust automated testing, and collaborative problem solving.
rounds: Round 1: Online Technical Assessment (2 Coding Problems, 90 mins)
Round 2: Technical Phone Screening (Algorithms & Data Structures)
Round 3-6: Onsite Interviews (3 DSA Rounds + 1 System Architecture + 1 Googliness & Leadership)
sample_questions: Given a 2D grid of obstacle cell costs, find the shortest path from start to target in minimum weighted time.
Design a distributed rate limiter capable of enforcing 100,000 requests/sec across worldwide edge clusters.
Implement an LRU (Least Recently Used) cache with O(1) time complexity for get and put operations.
Tell me about a time you encountered ambiguity in a technical project spec and how you resolved it.

name: Microsoft
culture: Emphasizes a growth mindset, customer-centric feature delivery, code quality, and cloud-native integration with Azure microservices.
rounds: Round 3: Technical Interview 2 (System Architecture & API Design)
Round 4: AA (As-Appropriate) Final Round (Leadership & Culture Fit)
sample_questions: Reverse a linked list in groups of size K.
Design a real-time collaborative document editor like Microsoft Word Online.
Explain how B-Tree index structures accelerate SQL database search execution times.

name: Amazon
culture: Heavy focus on 16 Leadership Principles (Customer Obsession, Ownership, Invent & Simplify, Bias for Action). Expect behavioral questions tied to STAR methodology in every round.
rounds: Round 1: Online Assessment (OA1 Debugging + OA2 Coding + Work Simulation)
Round 2-5: Onsite Loop (4 Technical Interviews, each including 20-30 mins of Leadership Principles STAR questions + 45 mins Coding/System Design)
sample_questions: Design an e-commerce shopping cart and inventory locking service handling Flash Sales.
Given an array of product review strings, find top K most frequent keywords.
Tell me about a time when you had to make a fast decision with incomplete data.

name: Meta
culture: Fast-paced execution ('Move Fast'), product impact at multi-billion user scale, strong focus on bug-free speed during coding interviews.
rounds: Round 1: Technical Screening (2 Coding Questions in 45 mins)
Round 2: Onsite Coding Round 1 (2 Questions, 45 mins)
Round 3: Onsite Coding Round 2 (2 Questions, 45 mins)
Round 4: Product Architecture & System Design (45 mins)
sample_questions: Write a function to return the lowest common ancestor of two nodes in a binary tree.
Design Facebook Newsfeed timeline architecture for 2 billion active daily users.
Find all valid palindrome substrings in a given string.
